pages.html:
☁ CloudSync

Simple, Transparent Plans

Choose the perfect plan for your team. All plans include a 14-day free trial.

Starter

$29/month

Perfect for small teams just getting started.

  • Up to 5 team members
  • 5 GB storage
  • Basic file synchronization
  • Email support
  • Advanced analytics
  • API access
  • Custom integrations
Most Popular

Professional

$79/month

Best for growing businesses and teams.

  • Up to 25 team members
  • 500 GB storage
  • Advanced file synchronization
  • Priority email & chat support
  • Advanced analytics
  • API access
  • Custom integrations

Enterprise

Custom/month

For large organizations with unique needs.

  • Unlimited team members
  • Unlimited storage
  • Real-time synchronization
  • 24/7 phone & dedicated support
  • Advanced analytics
  • API access
  • Custom integrations

What's Included in Every Plan

  • 14-day free trial, no credit card required
  • Secure end-to-end encryption
  • Version history and file recovery
  • Multi-device synchronization
  • GDPR and HIPAA compliant
  • 99.9% uptime guarantee

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I change plans anytime? ▼

Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately, and we'll prorate any charges based on your usage.

What happens after the 14-day free trial? ▼

After your 14-day free trial ends, your account will be paused. We won't charge your card unless you explicitly choose to upgrade to a paid plan. You can reactivate your account at any time.

Do you offer annual billing discounts? ▼

Yes! Annual billing is available for all plans and comes with a 20% discount. Starter plan is $278/year, Professional is $758/year. Enterprise customers should contact our sales team for custom annual pricing.

Is there a student or nonprofit discount? ▼

Absolutely! We offer 50% off our Professional plan for verified students and nonprofits. Please contact our support team at hello@cloudsync.io to apply for a discount code.

What payment methods do you accept? ▼

We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers for Enterprise customers. All payments are processed securely through Stripe.

Can I get a refund? ▼

We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with CloudSync, simply contact our support team and we'll process a full refund within 5 business days.
